name: venue
title: Venue
description: Where the event is, in words first: the name and address, landmark directions in plain speech, links out to a maps app (a geo: link on Android, Apple Maps on iPhones, and a plain web link everywhere, the only one on a desktop), how to get there by bus, ferry and car, and a short list of access notes that shows only the rows the author filled (white space counts as empty). A small drawn locator sits beside the words. No embedded map, no iframe, no third-party script. Reads in full without JavaScript.

budget.reason: One small module that builds two links from a point: about 3.5 KB with its comments. The drawn locator is inline SVG in the page, not code.

motif.gloss: No cultural motif; shared infrastructure, nothing drawn from a tradition.
